- **Anniversary Bands:** These rings feature multiple diamonds and fit nicely next to a wedding band. - **Diamond Stud Earrings:** A versatile everyday piece that fits any wardrobe. You can find classic styles starting around $1,450.[[1]](https://www.royalcoster.com/en/blogs/diamond-anniversary-the-best-gifts)
- **Necklaces and Pendants:** Ten-stone halo necklaces or solitaire pendants symbolize years spent together. Explore custom and traditional designs through [Kesslers Diamonds](https://www.kesslersdiamonds.com/anniversary-gifts/).[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:16325673360041187758,catalogid:15047164841153577635,gpcid:746962148945661096,mid:576462744606370584&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.kesslersdiamonds.com/anniversary-gifts/)
- **Luxury Statement Pieces:** For high-end luxury gifts, consider designer diamond bands and pendants from [Graff](https://www.graff.com/us-en/gifts/romantic-gifts/).[[1]](https://www.graff.com/us-en/gifts/romantic-gifts/)
